verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a knowledge-base app, but the evidence pack documents no first-party bulk action, such as multi-select edit, batch retag, or batch move. The plugin and HTTP APIs (single-method calls like insertBlock) are only developer building blocks a user could script bulk changes with. Queries are read-only retrieval, and whole-graph export belongs to the separate export story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
